724d7cd5a16c.dst: 「那些裂隙把土地磨成了塵，把我們的家磨成了廢墟，把我們的人磨成了無。」
724d7cd5a16c.flat: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."

5528238d73d8.src: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

5528238d73d8.flat: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

51d524d847a0.src: The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.
51d524d847a0.dst: 大海是最有智慧的老師。它在這裡已有百萬年，也將再在這裡百萬年。願意去理解它祕密的人，自己也能得到啟蒙。在浪邊待上片刻吧；只要你願意聽，它會讓你心中充滿驚奇。
51d524d847a0.flat: The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.

e530dc7329a5.dst: {p} 的護符常在公社裡由天賦異稟的精靈彼此分享、反覆改造。這些石頭雖然樸素，但受過精靈魔法祝福，能為佩戴者帶來安撫的能量。
e530dc7329a5.flat: {p} charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.

d89d1e0d4154.src: Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.
d89d1e0d4154.dst: 好好享受這一天賜給你的最長日照，並珍惜它，好讓你能把那份溫暖一路帶下去。

04d69b2e1402.dst: 於是，一支箭矢飛出，令那隻鳥的優雅永遠失落，自天空之中貫穿了牠的雙翼——就在你射下信天翁的那一天。
04d69b2e1402.flat: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.

c48616ee18b9.src: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?
c48616ee18b9.dst: 光是看著這條墜飾就讓你眼睛發痛。它到底該不該存在？
c48616ee18b9.flat: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?

e52279d87495.src: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."
e52279d87495.dst: 「反正一切都完蛋了。只要你不在乎，就沒有什麼傷得了你。」
e52279d87495.flat: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."

f3b684f7e1de.src: This item was named by someone from the community!
f3b684f7e1de.dst: 這件物品的名字是由社群的某個人取的！
f3b684f7e1de.flat: This item was named by someone from the community!

6a5d4e2b21a6.src: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."
6a5d4e2b21a6.dst: 「最淡的光永遠贏不了最濃的暗。只有同時懂得這兩者的人才活得下來。」
6a5d4e2b21a6.flat: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."

006be4090514.src: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.
006be4090514.dst: 總得有什麼來統治這個生態系，哪怕它已經扭曲成這樣。
006be4090514.flat: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.

6902617fc20d.src: Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.
6902617fc20d.dst: 你的顏色終將褪去，你的傲慢終將讓你失去一切。這是必然。
6902617fc20d.flat: Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.

7a81030ebc70.src: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.
7a81030ebc70.dst: 這條墜飾上的寶石因內蘊的熱而發出血紅的光，複製著某種搏動的火山心跳。每一次脈動之中，你的靈魂都會被那些葬身於灼熱火山灰的敵人重新點燃。
7a81030ebc70.flat: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.

44686a4ec177.src: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.
44686a4ec177.dst: 在黯蝕過境之後，這片土地渴望回到它昔日的生機。
44686a4ec177.flat: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.

0baf7d488d30.src: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.
0baf7d488d30.dst: 願你的功業永存，永不褪色。
0baf7d488d30.flat: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.

078dc6344cd6.src: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.
078dc6344cd6.dst: 這條墜飾其實不過是一顆綁在繩上的電池，但 Avos 與電魔法某種奇妙的組合，似乎讓它有了自行從周遭汲取電力的能力。
078dc6344cd6.flat: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.

bb392301201d.src: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.
bb392301201d.dst: 那是一場超越時間的決鬥，泰坦之間的碰撞。兩名如此相似、如此強大、卻又註定對立的士兵。但最後，一枚從鎖子甲上扯下來的變形鐵環留下了證詞：她毫無勝算——那名戰士，與自己的刃並不同心。
bb392301201d.flat: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.

8ff44ccc3b9f.src: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.
8ff44ccc3b9f.dst: 一股深沉的怒火落在你身上。那是對周遭世界、以及它一切可鄙缺陷的無盡憤懣。
8ff44ccc3b9f.flat: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.

492e42dc6f14.src: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.
492e42dc6f14.dst: 一股壓迫性的黑暗氣息自這副鐐銬散出，同時削弱佩戴者的意志與魔力強度。
492e42dc6f14.flat: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.

b34f2d2ad401.src: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.
b34f2d2ad401.dst: 光是看著這幾只古怪的戒指，就會生出一股非戴上兩只不可的衝動，哪怕理智明明在說不該。
b34f2d2ad401.flat: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.

8f2226912edc.src: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.
8f2226912edc.dst: 把自己交給黑暗，而在黑暗之中，答案自會成形。
8f2226912edc.flat: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

da77c4483e97.src: This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.It's pulling towards something.
da77c4483e97.dst: 這只手環同時被灌注了台地烈日的酷熱，與一團已熄滅的腐化之火的餘燼。任何東西碰它太久，都會無端起火。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
da77c4483e97.flat: This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.It's pulling towards something.

69e874a4bc8c.dst: 一件破壞的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的征服者。
69e874a4bc8c.flat: An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.

8ddd6902a066.flat: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?

a8ba6cdb9bba.dst: 這條手環頒發給傳奇挑戰的參加者。它的模組化設計讓它能以多種不同方式升級。

36966de17bb0.src: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.
36966de17bb0.dst: 一件強大到足以撼動大地的武器，因為人們畏懼它的原始力量而被摧毀，碎片就此埋起。幾十年後它們被挖了出來，重鍛成了各種物品，這副堅固的護腕就是其中之一。
36966de17bb0.flat: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.

e621247a2327.src: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.
e621247a2327.dst: 讓他們的靈魂唱出你的凱歌。
e621247a2327.flat: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.

2078e1e3624f.src: Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.
2078e1e3624f.dst: 與 Wynn 陣亡士兵的勇氣及殘存力量共鳴。每一次犧牲，都只會讓它注入配戴者心中的決意更加堅硬。
2078e1e3624f.flat: Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.

aed0b274f502.dst: 感受冷空氣那股新鮮的寒意，就足以讓你知道自己確實活著。
aed0b274f502.flat: Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.

e2b61d066139.src: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.
e2b61d066139.dst: 一件收養的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的照顧者。
e2b61d066139.flat: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.

22f3826a4e1b.src: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."
22f3826a4e1b.dst: 「我們全部的信仰、全部的敬拜，換來的獎賞是一場天啟。」
22f3826a4e1b.flat: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."

2071804f7e62.src: The forger of this ring had to endure {~} long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
2071804f7e62.dst: 打造這只戒指的人必須忍受 {~} 個漫長的日子，熔煉各種只在海洋中才找得到的金屬。只要出一次錯，整件作品就毀了。據說那些神祕金屬會滲入佩戴者的皮膚，溫和地補足他的意志。
2071804f7e62.flat: The forger of this ring had to endure {~} long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
2071804f7e62._raw: The forger of this ring had to endure 30 long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.

966a1fe0efde.src: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.
966a1fe0efde.dst: 串在這條樸素項鍊上的金珠所刻的符文，譯出來是各種代表「差異」的詞。它以無法解釋的方式提供了種種能力。
966a1fe0efde.flat: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.

7acf0ba1d87b.dst: 看得出有人想把它改良，然後失敗了。重鍛的手法明顯很趕……
7acf0ba1d87b.flat: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...

e7c2a341716b.src: The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.It's pulling towards something.
e7c2a341716b.dst: 死者通常會被焚燒，以免有回魂的風險。但對腐化的造物而言，那把火反而足以讓牠們再次爬起來。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
e7c2a341716b.flat: The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.It's pulling towards something.

0c5513132a7c.src: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.
0c5513132a7c.dst: 那具遲了好幾天才被發現的殘破屍體，顯然以為這條項鍊能讓他在間歇泉之間穿越到高地去。
0c5513132a7c.flat: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.

90acc4784d00.src: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.
90acc4784d00.dst: 陰影之中住著不可名狀的東西；牠們極有耐心地等著，要把別人也拉進自己的行列。那是牠們存在的複製品，以難以辨識的黑暗描摹而成。沒有人會看見。沒有人會知道。沒有人會記得。
90acc4784d00.flat: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

234f4a0fa05a.src: Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.
234f4a0fa05a.dst: 保持冷靜，保持掌控。最艱難的仗，光靠運氣是打不贏的。
234f4a0fa05a.flat: Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.

a84da6df12f5.src: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.
a84da6df12f5.dst: 一件分離的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的漂泊者。
a84da6df12f5.flat: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.

b7b16c7c6822.src: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"
b7b16c7c6822.dst: 烙在你皮膚上的字寫著：「概不退還！」
b7b16c7c6822.flat: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"

f300710222b4.flat: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.

5a695afba218.src: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.
5a695afba218.dst: 這條項鍊的終極版本，授予過的冒險者五根手指數得完。戴上之後，你能與腳下的大地交談，彷彿自己也長出了根。
5a695afba218.flat: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.

295a18312c13.src: This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.
295a18312c13.dst: 這件戒指傑作運用強大的電魔法，讓佩戴者感受到大地的心跳。戴著它，你能感到自己與腳下的土地有著深刻的連結。

3571889976fc.dst: 這款改良版項鍊傳來的強烈電擊，是換取它強度的一點小代價；不過它還沒到達顛峰。
3571889976fc.flat: The strong shock coming from this improved version of the necklace is a small price for its strength, but it has yet to reach its peak.

770fb7abcaca.src: The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.
770fb7abcaca.dst: 這款先進版戒指傳來的強烈電擊，是換取它力量的一點小代價；不過它還沒到達顛峰。
770fb7abcaca.flat: The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

1c84e0f35b73.src: This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.
1c84e0f35b73.dst: 這條令人印象深刻的手環需求極高。取得它的人說，戴上時會覺得自己「與風合而為一」。
1c84e0f35b73.flat: This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

aa25db9e43a8.src: The jewel hanging from this necklace is said to be weightless. While still very powerful, its full potential has yet to be achieved.
aa25db9e43a8.dst: 據說垂在這條項鍊上的寶石毫無重量。它雖然已經非常強大，完整的潛力卻尚未被發揮出來。
aa25db9e43a8.flat: The jewel hanging from this necklace is said to be weightless. While still very powerful, its full potential has yet to be achieved.

fd5d8ef20dd8.src: While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.
fd5d8ef20dd8.dst: 這款蒸氣戒指遠勝前一代，不過仍有再升級一次的餘地。戒面上的寶石清透如水晶。
fd5d8ef20dd8.flat: While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

8b4674a9e9dd.src: A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.It's pulling towards something.
8b4674a9e9dd.dst: 這副護手覆著厚厚一層血污與碎肉。每次你瞥它一眼，被亡者撕成碎片的畫面就會閃進腦海，讓你打了個寒顫。它正被某種東西牽引著。
8b4674a9e9dd.flat: A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.It's pulling towards something.

73e2f1a06489.src: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.
73e2f1a06489.dst: 原本設計來在戰場上重新啟動失能的戰爭機械。不過戴在脖子上時，它會在你每次做出較大動作時，直接朝頸靜脈打進高壓電擊。
73e2f1a06489.flat: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.

37520c2fa96d.src: Two sides of the same coin.
37520c2fa96d.flat: Two sides of the same coin.

b0221a6e62de.src: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.
b0221a6e62de.dst: 感受過城塞詛咒之力的這顆寶石，帶著一種熟悉的重量。一如你之前的歷代咒術宗師，你會發現引導詛咒對你來說如同本能。
b0221a6e62de.flat: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.

8f939494f8e3.src: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, {p}-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.
8f939494f8e3.dst: 雖然施加在這個樸素的 {p} 護符上的術士詛咒會大幅削弱佩戴者的能力，它原本增進幸運的特性倒是還在。
8f939494f8e3.flat: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, {p}-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.
8f939494f8e3._raw: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, Olux-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.

2554631cee3b.src: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.
2554631cee3b.dst: 穩定未必來自靜止，而是來自可預測。
2554631cee3b.flat: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.

43f218b5c341.src: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.
43f218b5c341.dst: 你站在世界的頂端，而往前唯一的路是往下。
43f218b5c341.flat: You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.

599735f9a134.src: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.
599735f9a134.dst: 你必須繼續動。你不能停在這裡。不能。你沒辦法呼吸。你沒辦法跑。你快死了。你撐不下去了。你不能。你不能。
599735f9a134.flat: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.

87e6331d6075.src: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.
87e6331d6075.flat: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.

4c8cbc067167.src: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.
4c8cbc067167.dst: 一件入侵的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的探索者。
4c8cbc067167.flat: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.

5a4b50e4904a.src: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.
5a4b50e4904a.dst: 刻在這只樸素金戒上的符文，譯出來是各種代表「力量」的詞。它以無法解釋的方式放大元素能量。
5a4b50e4904a.flat: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.

35e58ca81bb1.src: A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...
35e58ca81bb1.dst: 陛下為表彰鋼鐵指揮官的功績而賜下的禮物。要是他知道它代表著什麼就好了……
35e58ca81bb1.flat: A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...

5381bcc391b5.src: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.
5381bcc391b5.dst: Roughworks 的巧匠常反覆改造過時的零件，好尋找新的創新與可能。他們的手藝——你指上這一件就是其中之一——會驅使你繼續重複下去，突破新的界線。
5381bcc391b5.flat: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.

194ad44589c6.src: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.
194ad44589c6.dst: 峽谷武館所生產的布纏就只是布纏，不過是柔軟的布罷了。至於在戰鬥中怎麼用得高明，就看使用者自己了。
194ad44589c6.flat: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.

4a433861e99e.src: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.
4a433861e99e.dst: 一個道歉的象徵。象徵著並非有意、卻因粗心而造成的傷痛。象徵著被輕率與過度樂觀所毀掉的善意。把這樣一顆冰冷的珍珠送出去，等於把自己的一部分送出去，也等於給那些被你傷害過的人一份能得到平靜的希望。
4a433861e99e.flat: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.

83b2fc69a581.src: Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.
83b2fc69a581.dst: 溫和的風靈受這只戒指上鑲嵌的燦爛寶石吸引而聚來，為佩戴者以及他周遭的人帶來平靜。
83b2fc69a581.flat: Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

8c26a5634c4f.src: An old {p} saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
8c26a5634c4f.dst: 金屬上刻著一句 {p} 的老話：「賭徒的成敗，就在骰子這一擲之間。」
8c26a5634c4f.flat: An old {p} saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
8c26a5634c4f._raw: An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."

2d52ff516bf8.src: An uncountably old relic of {p} which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
2d52ff516bf8.dst: 一件古老到無法計數年歲的 {p} 遺物，每一次易主都只透過死亡；它上面刻著一行字：「吃，或者被吃」
2d52ff516bf8.flat: An uncountably old relic of {p} which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
2d52ff516bf8._raw: An uncountably old relic of Time Valley which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'

e8c35b1802da.src: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.
e8c35b1802da.dst: 這面徽章標誌著佩戴者是一位真正的冠軍。它頒發給那些在傳奇挑戰上投入了不必要之多時間的人。
e8c35b1802da.flat: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.

4f58f1aa7c20.src: It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.It's pulling towards something.
4f58f1aa7c20.dst: 事實證明，讓一團帶酸性、還有點腐化的史萊姆黏在手上，在戰鬥中確實有好處……不過你大概還是該趁它把你指骨上的肉吃光之前，把那東西弄掉。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
4f58f1aa7c20.flat: It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.It's pulling towards something.

3c64daa5cc79.src: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.
3c64daa5cc79.dst: 那種被稱為天然磁石的魔法怪物，多年來一直被當作水晶被動魔法特性的主動對照組來研究。研究仍在進行，但它在製作魔法物品時價值不菲。
3c64daa5cc79.flat: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.

96ac9de2c949.src: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.
96ac9de2c949.dst: 這只戒指上鑲著一顆美麗而令人著迷的寶石。你可以盯著它看上好幾個小時。好幾個小時，又好幾個小時。
96ac9de2c949.flat: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.

650c159f3721.src: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.
650c159f3721.dst: 你幾乎注意不到這條手環上刻著字。湊近一看，那些磨損的銘文正訴說著一位你並不認識的遠古英雄的傳說。
650c159f3721.flat: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.

53e2b9fefe13.src: Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.
53e2b9fefe13.dst: 以一顆纏繞著奧術符印的深海寶石雕成，這條墜飾會把懷有惡意的凝視扭轉回它的來源，讓佩戴者毫髮無傷。
53e2b9fefe13.flat: Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.

42932ac128b8.src: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.
42932ac128b8.dst: 一個剛結婚的男人戴著這只婚戒上了戰場。儘管他戰死沙場，他的勇氣與決心仍賦予每一個戴上它的人力量。
42932ac128b8.flat: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.

25e98e28ffd8.src: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.
25e98e28ffd8.dst: 鑲在這只戒指上的珊瑚寶石那卓越的品質，來自一道魔法淨化程序——在神祕的 Gylia 之水中浸泡整整十年。
25e98e28ffd8.flat: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.

55fa992424df.src: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.
55fa992424df.dst: 雖然嚴格說來一點也不魔法，這枚華麗胸針純粹的工藝就足以讓佩戴者覺得自己技藝高超。
55fa992424df.flat: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.

e9d19a9ffdf1.src: This rather nondescript band has something etched into the inside, almost too small to make out: nasef kec. nah il kaclof toc profrets adnales recnal nec niftoc. nah il pahisah nikcol ah krof kacetslah cef. ahas nifloc pokc il sofmalis pokces toc cef. tah il cistod uc secnof if {#}ef reftif, nah il kacetslah pahisah sef krahos. tahes il hocel uc sifed if.
e9d19a9ffdf1.dst: 這條相當不起眼的環帶內側刻著什麼，小到幾乎看不清楚：nasef kec. nah il kaclof toc profrets adnales recnal nec niftoc. nah il pahisah nikcol ah krof kacetslah cef. ahas nifloc pokc il sofmalis pokces toc cef. tah il cistod uc secnof if {#}ef reftif, nah il kacetslah pahisah sef krahos. tahes il hocel uc sifed if.
e9d19a9ffdf1.flat: This rather nondescript band has something etched into the inside, almost too small to make out: nasef kec. nah il kaclof toc profrets adnales recnal nec niftoc. nah il pahisah nikcol ah krof kacetslah cef. ahas nifloc pokc il sofmalis pokces toc cef. tah il cistod uc secnof if ef reftif, nah il kacetslah pahisah sef krahos. tahes il hocel uc sifed if.

59a22983ff56.src: What you have seen will mark you forever.
59a22983ff56.dst: 你所見過的那些，將永遠在你身上留下記號。
59a22983ff56.flat: What you have seen will mark you forever.

44649d43f117.src: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.
44649d43f117.dst: 太陽都懼怕牠的雙翼，你的敵人也將如此。
44649d43f117.flat: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.

cbfe66b29967.src: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.
cbfe66b29967.dst: 它現在完全沒辦法拿來做本來該做的事了。光是要套進手指就已經很勉強。
cbfe66b29967.flat: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.

cff039887658.src: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.
cff039887658.dst: 這只金環周身帶著一種奇異的時間膨脹效應，會大幅減緩所有動作，卻也把衝擊的力道放大到相當可觀的程度。
cff039887658.flat: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.

05775d3dc55c.src: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.
05775d3dc55c.dst: 在 Fruma 紅木林一帶流傳的眾多迷信裡，有一則是關於這條項鍊上那塊會反光的石頭。凝視它的人聲稱看見了一個扭曲的自己回望過來——而那個自己，會把觀看者靈魂中最深的缺陷放到最大。
05775d3dc55c.flat: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.

0ad689cbd00a.src: Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.It's pulling towards something.
0ad689cbd00a.dst: 木乃伊一死，它施加的詛咒就會解除。儘管木乃伊已被擊敗，在原本平靜的時刻裡，牠瘋狂的尖嘯仍會刺進你的耳朵。它正被某種東西牽引著。
0ad689cbd00a.flat: Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.It's pulling towards something.

f36ce1eae1ed.src: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.
f36ce1eae1ed.dst: 這條項鍊被昔日的 Avos 封印起來，以免落入不該落入的手中；它被施法強化，能加深佩戴者與自然本身的靈性連結。
f36ce1eae1ed.flat: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.

8c21f5dc566b.src: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"
8c21f5dc566b.dst: 「守護者在這之後也還是會保護我們的！它一定會，它必須，它——」
8c21f5dc566b.flat: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"

cef905b2814e.src: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.
cef905b2814e.dst: 在 Gavel 行省最年長的店主屍體上尋獲，上面刻著一個詞：「貪婪」。
cef905b2814e.flat: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.

eb43ff534a0b.src: Beneath engravings of the Fruman capital, you can make out some text: nikcatl rakc il las uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las{#} uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.
eb43ff534a0b.dst: 在 Fruma 首都的雕紋底下，你辨認得出一些文字：nikcatl rakc il las{#} uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.
eb43ff534a0b.flat: Beneath engravings of the Fruman capital, you can make out some text: nikcatl rakc il las uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.

dedd2d584158.src: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.
dedd2d584158.dst: 這條項鍊上的寶石會自然而然地把黑暗與腐化吸進配戴者體內，以配戴者自己的性命為代價，淨化他周圍的土地。
dedd2d584158.flat: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.

a42cfd38f725.src: Your mind is falling apart, the pieces scattering, your grasp on reality weakening, your soul an empty space. I shall fill it.

69a79814af38.src: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-{~}M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.
69a79814af38.dst: 強大的 TERA-{~}M 採礦機器人系列的輔助動力核心。它會讓持有者生出一股不顧一切要開闢新地、不斷向前推進的衝動，藉此控制那些機器人。
69a79814af38.flat: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-{~}M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.
69a79814af38._raw: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.

7f6152ef6b01.src: The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.
7f6152ef6b01.dst: 冰涼奶油的口感。濃郁燉肉那份鹹香的滿足。巧克力的苦甜。那些隨著往昔一併失落的奢侈，那些再也找不回來的味道與感受。光是這樣，就足以讓一個人流下苦澀而苦澀的淚。
7f6152ef6b01.flat: The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.

d36ba06d8945.src: This relic has been passed down through the ages, from conman to charlatan to chiseller. It grants an inexplicable sense of candor to your words.
d36ba06d8945.dst: 這件遺物代代相傳，從騙徒傳到江湖術士，再傳到坑蒙拐騙之徒手上。它會賦予你的話語一種難以解釋的誠懇。
d36ba06d8945.flat: This relic has been passed down through the ages, from conman to charlatan to chiseller. It grants an inexplicable sense of candor to your words.

27bc57f06905.src: Survival is the shared interest of those in the wilds.
27bc57f06905.dst: 在荒野裡，活下去是所有人共同的利益。
27bc57f06905.flat: Survival is the shared interest of those in the wilds.

1889d23ac11e.src: This strange pendant has been known to dilate time around the wearer, slowing their movements while greatly augmenting their power.
1889d23ac11e.dst: 這條奇特的墜飾已知會讓佩戴者周遭的時間膨脹，在大幅增強其力量的同時，也放慢他的動作。
1889d23ac11e.flat: This strange pendant has been known to dilate time around the wearer, slowing their movements while greatly augmenting their power.

999ed75e8e8a.src: Everything that's fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that's where you come in.
999ed75e8e8a.dst: 掉到這下面來的每一樣東西都有它的用途。至少，曾經有過。離那個用途太遠，終究會把它悶熄；不過它永遠可以被重新點燃……而那，就是你出場的地方。
999ed75e8e8a.flat: Everything that's fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that's where you come in.

0225196df502.src: Looking over the horizon, you suddenly realize the span of your journey. How far you've come. How far you'll go.
0225196df502.dst: 望向地平線，你忽然意識到自己這趟旅程的跨度。你已經走了多遠。你還會走多遠。
0225196df502.flat: Looking over the horizon, you suddenly realize the span of your journey. How far you've come. How far you'll go.

b53fe75e0641.src: Limitless light fills the vast expanse of your mind.  Harness even a fraction of its potential, and you can command a force to shake worlds.
b53fe75e0641.dst: 無盡的光充滿你心智的浩瀚。只要駕馭它其中一小部分的潛能，你就能號令一股足以撼動世界的力量。
b53fe75e0641.flat: Limitless light fills the vast expanse of your mind.  Harness even a fraction of its potential, and you can command a force to shake worlds.

3c2af0ad749c.src: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.
3c2af0ad749c.dst: 燈光開始一盞一盞緩緩熄滅。你剩下的時間已經不多了。
3c2af0ad749c.flat: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.

040ae65e19a9.src: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.
040ae65e19a9.dst: 你看到重影了。也許那是因為，那裡的現實不只一個。
040ae65e19a9.flat: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.

ca51df8a22c2.src: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.
ca51df8a22c2.dst: 她的審判從一開始就是安排好的。對於他們指控她做過的那些事，她本不該得到任何正義。如今監獄就是她的世界，而壓在她靈魂上的重擔，只有頸間那條鐵鏈的重量堪可比擬。
ca51df8a22c2.flat: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.

92a1f17d123b.src: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from {p} who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.
92a1f17d123b.dst: 傳聞 {p} 曾有一位廚師做出了完美的一餐。在生命的最後那段日子裡，他把那道菜的精華封存進這條項鍊，盼望有別人能分享他當時的體驗。
92a1f17d123b.flat: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from {p} who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.
92a1f17d123b._raw: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.

834cf02c7f86.src: It doesn't matter that you meant well.
834cf02c7f86.dst: 你是出於好意，但那並不重要。
834cf02c7f86.flat: It doesn't matter that you meant well.

fe613bf8f0a6.src: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.
fe613bf8f0a6.dst: 持有這件受詛玻璃小飾品的人會失去語言能力。取下之後效果會解除，但戴得愈久，詛咒殘留的時間也愈長。
fe613bf8f0a6.flat: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.

1c0e1c8b463b.src: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.
1c0e1c8b463b.dst: 你怎麼看都覺得那是狗掌，不過你也不想拿命去跟商人爭。
1c0e1c8b463b.flat: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.

d81d919e084a.flat: Your magic pops open the locket, revealing an inscription inside: necel il lokc tahnulpef cef. priftac ilis las uc traspedis ac ickah il necel nedrid uc akcnofmosed. tahrefets il kacetslah pahpestal, luh necel ciltuh il pecetslah nikcpelasred cefos. tah il tof uc nikceladnalah krahos kal, etlsul il pahsofmal tofnikcifrahosed. tah il tof toc kahatsnus.

d70de7a9a9c7.src: Revel in the respect you've finally earned.
d70de7a9a9c7.dst: 好好享受你終於掙來的敬重吧。
d70de7a9a9c7.flat: Revel in the respect you've finally earned.

6ed99e6a8556.src: Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.
6ed99e6a8556.dst: Stackpeak 之鷹以對靠近巢穴的冒險者充滿攻擊性而聞名。不過在那份敵意底下，其實是保護雛鳥不受入侵者傷害的本能。
6ed99e6a8556.flat: Stackpeak hawks are known for their aggression towards adventurers approching their nests. However, under the hawks' hostility lies the instincts to protect the younglings from invaders.

36767e114f32.src: Your world crumbles around you even as your senses heighten. Get out while you still can.
36767e114f32.dst: 你的世界在身邊崩塌，而你的感官同時變得無比敏銳。趁還走得掉的時候走。
36767e114f32.flat: Your world crumbles around you even as your senses heighten. Get out while you still can.

18230cf6a648.src: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher
18230cf6a648.dst: 「人家說眼睛是靈魂之窗。荒謬，眼球液基本上是不透明的。」—Ragon，元素研究員
18230cf6a648.flat: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher

048f61ba8749.src: Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.It's pulling towards something.
048f61ba8749.dst: 士兵們都說，不死大軍的聲音是整個 Wynn 最令人恐懼的聲響之一。戴上這枚戒指，腐化軍團那猙獰的嚎叫會永遠在你腦中迴盪。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
048f61ba8749.flat: Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.It's pulling towards something.

6c0e84cd0623.src: The extra metal on the glove completely defeats the purpose... It's unclear why it was re-smithed like this.
6c0e84cd0623.dst: 手套上多加的金屬完全違背了它的用意……實在不懂為什麼要這樣重鍛。
6c0e84cd0623.flat: The extra metal on the glove completely defeats the purpose... It's unclear why it was re-smithed like this.

0ddcd2d28030.src: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.
0ddcd2d28030.dst: 世界在你四周糊成一片。旋轉的色塊交織、混融，朝每一個方向暈成一團光。你最不該做的事，就是停下來。
0ddcd2d28030.flat: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.

4e9eb0b2f5f0.flat: "My dear boy should never have to go through the horrors of losing a mother like that." -Momo, adoptive mother of Bob

4297c778ecbe.src: Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplant your failing heart.
4297c778ecbe.dst: 你的血肉不過是力量拙劣的仿製品，一團湧著血的鬆軟與脆弱的骨，用幾條微弱希望的線縫在一起。只有一條路走得通：你必須把那顆正在衰竭的心臟換掉。
4297c778ecbe.flat: Your flesh is but a weak imitation of power, a flabby welter of gushing blood and brittle bones, stitched together with threads of weak hope. There is only one way through: you must supplant your failing heart.
